name: myowndesignmd
description: Local-first multi-page website design-system scanner that generates DESIGN.md using Playwright and Ollama.

scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build && tsup server/index.ts --format esm --platform node --target node20 --out-dir dist-server --sourcemap
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.clean: node -e "const f=require('node:fs'); for (const p of ['dist','dist-server']) f.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
